coordinate_system: clip-fixed inferred support frame; model-estimated meters; y normal to inferred local floor
score_semantics: 2D RTMPose confidence; not a calibrated 3D confidence

scene.anchor_policy: early foot median projected onto inferred local plane; contact uncertain
scene.contacts_semantics: Soft marker-specific support hypotheses, not calibrated contact probabilities
scene.anatomy_semantics: SMPL joint centers; procedural bone graphics are illustrative

limitations: Uncalibrated monocular inference. Camera/floor/contact are estimated; no measured stride ground truth, surveyed mound plane or OpenSim IK.
